ITA-1.9.3.3.27 lajjā लज्जा
Shyness
A term that expresses modesty, sense of decency or decorum.

lājā लाजा
Parched paddy
A preparation of roasted grains which is easily digestible.

lājapeyā लाजपेया
Thin gruel of parched grain
A thin gruel prepared from parched grains.

lājamaṇḍaḥ लाजमण्डः
Liquid portion of parched grain gruel
The liquid portion of gruel prepared from parched grains

lājasaktuḥ लाजसक्तुः
Flour of roasted parched grain
A type of food preparation made from the flour of roasted parched grain by adding water and sugar, and mixing it to the consistency of paste.
